mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_PHOTO_GRP (COMP_CD, GRP_DT, TITLE, PHOTO_CNT, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_NM, REG_IP) VALUES (#{compCd}, #{grpDt}, #{title,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, 0, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{regNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{regIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT GRP_SEQ AS grpSeq, GRP_DT AS grpDt, ISNULL(TITLE,'') AS title, PHOTO_CNT AS photoCnt, ISNULL(REG_USER,'') AS regUser FROM TBL_PHOTO_GRP WHERE COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND GRP_SEQ = #{grpSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_PHOTO (GRP_SEQ, COMP_CD, SORT_NO, FILE_NM, SHOT_DTTM, IMG_W, IMG_H, IMG_BYTES, IMG, THUMB, REG_DTTM, REG_USER) VALUES (#{grpSeq}, #{compCd}, #{sortNo}, #{fileNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{shotDttm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{imgW,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{imgH,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{imgBytes,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{img,jdbcType=VARBINARY}, #{thumb,jdbcType=VARBINARY}, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_PHOTO_GRP SET PHOTO_CNT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_PHOTO p WHERE p.GRP_SEQ = TBL_PHOTO_GRP.GRP_SEQ) WHERE COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND GRP_SEQ = #{grpSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT GRP_DT AS grpDt, COUNT(*) AS grpCnt, SUM(PHOTO_CNT) AS photoCnt FROM TBL_PHOTO_GRP WHERE COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND GRP_DT >= #{frDt} AND GRP_DT <= #{toDt} AND PHOTO_CNT > 0 GROUP BY GRP_DT ORDER BY GRP_DT DESC

SELECT GRP_SEQ AS grpSeq, GRP_DT AS grpDt, ISNULL(TITLE,'') AS title, PHOTO_CNT AS photoCnt, ISNULL(REG_DTTM,'') AS regDttm, ISNULL(REG_USER,'') AS regUser, ISNULL(NULLIF(REG_NM,''), ISNULL(REG_USER,'')) AS regNm FROM TBL_PHOTO_GRP WHERE COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND GRP_DT >= #{frDt} AND GRP_DT <= #{toDt} AND PHOTO_CNT > 0 ORDER BY GRP_DT DESC, GRP_SEQ DESC

SELECT p.PHOTO_SEQ AS photoSeq, p.GRP_SEQ AS grpSeq, p.SORT_NO AS sortNo, ISNULL(p.FILE_NM,'') AS fileNm, ISNULL(p.SHOT_DTTM,'') AS shotDttm, p.IMG_W AS imgW, p.IMG_H AS imgH, p.IMG_BYTES AS imgBytes FROM TBL_PHOTO p JOIN TBL_PHOTO_GRP g ON g.GRP_SEQ = p.GRP_SEQ AND g.COMP_CD = p.COMP_CD WHERE p.COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND g.GRP_DT >= #{frDt} AND g.GRP_DT <= #{toDt} ORDER BY g.GRP_DT DESC, g.GRP_SEQ DESC, p.SORT_NO, p.PHOTO_SEQ
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_PHOTO WHERE COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND PHOTO_SEQ = #{photoSeq}
DELETE FROM TBL_PHOTO WHERE COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND GRP_SEQ = #{grpSeq}
DELETE FROM TBL_PHOTO_GRP WHERE COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND GRP_SEQ = #{grpSeq}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_PHOTO_GRP SET TITLE = #{title,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} WHERE COMP_CD = #{compCd} AND GRP_SEQ = #{grpSeq}
mapper.delete: DELETE TOP (2000) p FROM TBL_PHOTO p WHERE p.GRP_SEQ IN (SELECT g.GRP_SEQ FROM TBL_PHOTO_GRP g WHERE g.GRP_DT < #{cutDt})
DELETE FROM TBL_PHOTO_GRP WHERE GRP_DT < #{cutDt} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_PHOTO p WHERE p.GRP_SEQ = TBL_PHOTO_GRP.GRP_SEQ)
DELETE FROM TBL_PHOTO_GRP WHERE GRP_DT < #{yday} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_PHOTO p WHERE p.GRP_SEQ = TBL_PHOTO_GRP.GRP_SEQ)
